messages:
Raj Patel: Hey deal-desk, need urgent pricing exception for Adamas. Requesting 35% off hosted + dedicated pricing for a 12mo commit ($240k list). Strategic win + potential case study. Need approval by EOD PT. TL;DR: 35% to close, otherwise they walk.

Maya Torres: Can you post the margin calc and commitment profile? 35% is above the standard threshold. Also include security questionnaire status and whether premium support is required.

Raj Patel: Quick numbers:
```
List price monthly: $20,000
12mo gross: $240,000
35% off => $156,000
Estimated net margin (ballpark): ~48% after infra & support
Customer asks: private VPC + 2 dedicated clusters (SLA)
```
Reference: Adamas is a fintech pilot, high visibility, possible multi-region later.

Luca Bianchi: Need an accurate cost breakdown, not a ballpark. Please send per-node infra cost + ops headcount delta. Also clarify whether this includes premium support.

Raj Patel: Ops cost note: dedicated infra ~ $35k/mo (amortized nodes + network), standard support included. Will pull precise cost sheet. Attaching security note: they require SOC2 and some compliance language.

Ana Gomez: Heads up: dedicated pools + onboarding will increase CSM and runbook work. We need CSM assignment before go-live.

Maya Torres: I can greenlight up to 30% internally. Anything >30% needs Finance + CRO signoff. Please fill the pricing exception form and attach the SecQA and expected E2E timeline.

Raj Patel: Filing exception now. Request ID PR-2026-087.

deploy-bot: New pricing exception PR-2026-087 created by Raj Patel. Status: pending_review.

Raj Patel: Proposed compromise: approve 30% upfront, additional 5% as a usage-contingent rebate post go-live (trigger: sustained usage >2TB embeddings/month for 2 consecutive months). That protects margin and ties discount to expansion.

Luca Bianchi: Rebate needs explicit contract language and modeling for committed vs overage. Also need to account for burst capacity costs if they exceed planned peaks.

Maya Torres: OK — I'm +30% provisional. For the additional 5% rebate path we need Legal + Finance to sign off and a clear SLO and SLA in SOW. Please @Sophie Legal and @CRO for review.

Raj Patel: pinging Sophie Legal and CRO for final on rebate language. If we get provisional 30% now I can close SOW and start onboarding.

deploy-bot: Deal routing updated: PR-2026-087 linked to opportunity 00543-Adamas.

Sophie Legal: I'll review the rebate mechanics and SOC2 wording. Need the SOW draft and the SecQA responses to proceed.

Maya Torres: Final for now: Approved 30% discount. The extra 5% is contingent on Legal + Finance signoff and contract language for rebate. Raj, route SOW, SecQA, and the cost backup to me and Sophie.

Raj Patel: Got it — routing SOW + SecQA + cost sheet to Maya and Sophie now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
